_readme: Shape of the PTE JSON the Go backend returns, written for the frontend.
Every value below is a TYPE DESCRIPTION in the form '<type> - <what it is>'.
There is no sample content here on purpose: this file is a contract, not a
fixture. Do not import it or render from it.
It mirrors src/lib/types/index.ts, which in turn mirrors the backend models.
If the two ever disagree, the backend wins and both files get corrected.
IELTS uses the same envelopes and the same objects - only the task types in

conventions.baseUrl: /api/v1 - same-origin; next.config.js proxies it to the Go backend
conventions.auth: HttpOnly cookie 'prepyo_session', sent automatically; there is no bearer token for page scripts to read
conventions.optional: a field marked 'optional' is absent from the JSON, not null - check with `if (q.audioUrl)`
conventions.nullable: an explicit null means 'not enough data yet'; render 'no data', never substitute 0
conventions.timestamps: string - RFC 3339 UTC, e.g. the format Date.parse understands
conventions.ids: string - opaque; compare for equality, never parse or sort by them
conventions.grading: the server scores everything; the browser never decides correctness

success._note: handlers return their payload at the top level - there is no 'data' wrapper
success.<payloadKey>: the object or array named by the endpoint below

error._note: any non-2xx, plus any body carrying success:false, is thrown as ApiError by src/lib/api.ts
error.success: boolean - always false on this envelope

error.code: string - the stable value to branch on; never show it to a learner
error.message: string - learner-facing copy, written by the server only for the codes listed in SERVER_WORDED
error.fields: object, optional - map of field name to validation message, for form errors

knownErrorCodes.unauthorized: no session or it expired - send the learner to /login
knownErrorCodes.not_found: no such question, mock or attempt
knownErrorCodes.limit_reached: a plan allowance ran out, e.g. daily AI evaluations
knownErrorCodes.ai_unavailable: the AI provider is unreachable - the answer was still saved

GET /questions?exam=PTE&skill=<skill>._use: fills the practice screen; one call per skill, filtered client-side by task type
GET /questions?exam=PTE&skill=<skill>.questions: Question[] - delivery form, so it never carries answers

_request.selectedOptions: string[], optional - QuestionOption ids the learner chose
_request.blankResponses: object, optional - map of Blank id to the learner's word
_request.timeSpentSeconds: number, optional - measured by the client, advisory only

_response.review: Question - the same question re-sent WITH correctAnswers, modelAnswer and explanation filled in
_response.xpAwarded: number - 0 when the attempt earned nothing

_request.text: string - required, the learner's full response

POST /evaluations/speaking._use: speaking - the model listens to the recording itself, transcribing it and scoring pronunciation and fluency from the audio, not from the transcript

_request.audio: string - required, base64 of the encoded file, no data: URI prefix
_request.format: string - required, 'mp3' or 'wav' - send what encodeForUpload returns, do not assume (src/lib/audio.ts)
_request.durationSeconds: number - required, length of the take

_response.evaluation: Evaluation - `transcript` is what was actually heard; absent or empty means no speech was made out

GET /mocks/{mockId}.questions: Question[] - every section's questions in one payload, ordered as sat

Question._note: the delivery form. correctAnswers, modelAnswer and explanation MUST be absent here - they appear only on the `review` object returned after a submission, or the answers leak to the browser.
Question.examVersionId: string - historical attempts stay pinned to the version they were taken under
Question.typeId: string - stable task-type id; group and filter on this
Question.typeName: string - human label for the task type, e.g. what the practice sidebar shows as a heading
Question.title: string - short name for the question
Question.prompt: string - the instruction shown to the learner
Question.contextPassage: string, optional - passage or script that stays on screen while answering
Question.audioUrl: string, optional - when absent the browser reads audioTranscript aloud and labels it synthesised
Question.audioTranscript: string, optional - the script behind the audio
Question.imageUrl: string, optional - the figure to describe
Question.prepTimeSeconds: number, optional - countdown before recording starts on its own
Question.timeLimitSeconds: number - the answer window; recording stops here
Question.options: QuestionOption[], optional - present for choice and ordering tasks
Question.blanks: Blank[], optional - present for fill-in-the-blanks tasks
Question.points: number - the maximum score this question can award

QuestionOption.id: string - send this back in selectedOptions, not the text

Blank.id: string - key it by this in blankResponses
Blank.options: string[], optional - present makes it a dropdown, absent makes it a free-text box

PracticeAttempt.userResponse: string, optional - what was submitted, echoed back

Evaluation.evaluationVersion: string - which rubric produced this; keep it with the result
Evaluation.estimatedScore: number | null - null when the model could not produce a defensible score; show a dash, not 0
Evaluation.modelRewrite: string, optional - an improved version of the answer
Evaluation.transcript: string, optional - speaking only; what the recording was heard as. Show it: every score below refers to these words

SentenceFeedback.issueType: string - short tag for the error kind

Mock.title: string
Mock.isDiagnostic: boolean - short baseline test rather than a full mock

MockSection.name: string
MockSection.questionIds: string[] - resolve against the questions array from GET /mocks/{mockId}

MockAttempt.skillScores: object - partial map of skill to score; a missing skill was not attempted

_readme: How each PTE task type arrives and how its answer goes back.
'questionFields' lists the optional Question fields the frontend expects to
be populated for that task type - it is what decides which control renders.
'submitWith' names the request field the answer belongs in.
Per prepyo-docs/EXAMS.md the production taxonomy must be verified against
the applicable exam specification. Treat these task names as UNVERIFIED
until that check is done; typeId, not typeName, is what code should match on.

questionFields: options - each option is one paragraph
Re-order Paragraphs.submitWith: selectedOptions - the option ids in the learner's chosen order
Re-order Paragraphs._gap: the practice screen currently renders options as checkboxes, which cannot express an order; this task type needs a drag-to-rank control before it can be answered correctly
